        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1000000)

        self.aig = self.AddEquity("AIG", Resolution.Daily).Symbol

        self.sma_period = 50
        self.sma = self.SMA(self.spy, self.sma_period, Resolution.Daily)

        self.rsi_period = 14
        self.rsi = self.RSI(self.aapl, self.rsi_period, MovingAverageType.Wilders, Resolution.Daily)

        # so "yesterday" always means the previous fully-evaluated day.
        self.prev_spy_close = None
        self.prev_spy_sma = None
        self.prev_aapl_close = None
        self.b_red_streak = 0

    def OnData(self, data: Slice):
        for symbol in self.all_symbols:
            if not data.Bars.ContainsKey(symbol) or data.Bars[symbol] is None:
                return

        spy_price = data.Bars[self.spy].Close
        aapl_price = data.Bars[self.aapl].Close

        # ---- Strategy B market state: consecutive red days ----
        if self.prev_aapl_close is not None and aapl_price < self.prev_aapl_close:
            self.b_red_streak += 1
        else:
            self.b_red_streak = 0

        # ---- Strategy A market state: SMA cross ----
        sma_ready = self.sma.IsReady
        crossed_above = False
        crossed_below = False
        sma_value = None
        if sma_ready:
            sma_value = self.sma.Current.Value
            if self.prev_spy_sma is not None and self.prev_spy_close is not None:
                crossed_above = (self.prev_spy_close <= self.prev_spy_sma) and (spy_price > sma_value)
                crossed_below = (self.prev_spy_close >= self.prev_spy_sma) and (spy_price < sma_value)

        # ---- Strategy A: sell before buy ----
        spy_qty = self.Portfolio[self.spy].Quantity
        if spy_qty > 0:
            if crossed_below:
                self.Liquidate(self.spy)
        else:
            if crossed_above:
                target_value = 0.40 * self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue
                if spy_price > 0:
                    qty = math.floor(target_value / spy_price)
                    if qty > 0:
                        self.MarketOrder(self.spy, qty)

        # ---- Strategy B: sell before buy ----
        aapl_qty = self.Portfolio[self.aapl].Quantity
        if aapl_qty > 0:
            if self.rsi.IsReady and self.rsi.Current.Value > 60:
                self.Liquidate(self.aapl)

                    qty = math.floor(target_cash / aapl_price)
                    if qty > 0:
                        self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, qty)

        self.prev_spy_close = spy_price
        if sma_ready:
            self.prev_spy_sma = sma_value
        self.prev_aapl_close = aapl_price
